cases.limits: Checks provided camera profile numeric validity; base rendering permits omission. Full showcase requires calibration. Does not prove framing, UI visibility, motion coverage or second-character acceptance.
Checks normalized finite atlas coordinates and positive/increasing intervals. Does not prove texture semantics, fitted regions, restoration or second-character quality; use fixed GPU evidence.

Checks finite comic calibration, canonical anchor bone and three ordered card dimensions. Authored placement, animation, birth pinning, skin fit and real hair occlusion require runtime evidence; passing the definition is not visual acceptance.
Checks configured rain profile structure, indices and binary lengths; does not prove binary semantics, atlas quality, reciprocal adjacency or actual Body correspondence.
Checks four nonempty wetness Texture2D resources and finite tear UV upper bounds within [0,1]; does not prove channel semantics, UV alignment, baked eye-region compatibility or rain simulation data.
Validates four-slot inputs, geometry arrays and indices, swatches, performance bone names, material scene nodes and StandardMaterial3D inputs. Does not prove attachment fit or visual quality.

Checks textures, Body domain, cuff and textile scale values, leg AO calibration bounds, and optional normal correction structure/count/source positions. Does not prove baked repeat counts, full triangle topology, texture semantics, seam placement, domain alignment or visual fit.

Checks configured eye scene root, direct surface names/materials, finite landmark centers, optical parameter ranges and 65-column uniform lid sampling. Does not prove optical fit or lid closure quality.
Checks profile centers, radii, scales and finite values. Face-domain coverage, fitted geometry and visual masking require runtime evidence.
Validates dynamic palette, chain, skin weights, contact samples and source counts. Does not prove triangle collision coverage, visual continuity or model-specific motion quality.
Validates sparse corrective indices, finite deltas, pressure range and Body vertex count. Collision safety and semantic deformation region require model-specific evidence.
Validates ordered canonical bones, acyclic parent references and finite nonzero actor-rest endpoints. Does not prove anatomical fit or animation quality.
Validates schema 1 actions, skin influences, face deltas and source topology. Does not establish deformation aesthetics or validate separate hair/soft-tissue assets.
Checks authored profile and lid structure/index validity. UV-region topology fit is additionally checked during eye-shape generation; visual closure needs captures.
Production definition and geometry validation only; texture semantics and full-feature datasets remain explicit unassessed items.
No universal numerical softness threshold is defined. The non-AI route supplies evidence and requires manual interpretation.
